title: Traverse Board project config (project_config.v1)
description: Narrowing-only project file at <workspace>/.prayu/config.yaml. Every field can only reduce operator/process/policy limits; widening attempts are rejected fail-closed.

exclude_paths.description: Pinned root-relative file-tool exclusions. Supports *, ?, character classes and whole ** segments; matching directories excludes descendants. Not an OS command sandbox.

skill_suggestions.description: Exact built-in or already installed package refs offered for explicit task selection before the first turn. Never automatically installed or enabled.

test_command_id.description: Registered ID only. Executable native presets: test.go (go test ./...), test.node (node --test), test.npm (native Node plus installed npm CLI test script, optional relative package scope), using existing command runtime permissions and Job receipts.

format_command_id.description: Registered ID only. Executable format.go preset prepares gofmt -w for one exact allowed relative Go file; rejected for read-only projects.
